exploitationMechanisms: Exploit reply weighting: Algorithm prioritizes posts with high reply velocity in first 30 mins; flood with sockpuppet replies agreeing/disagreeing to boost.
Leverage quote reposts: Quotes inherit 20-50% of original post's reach if timed right, amplifying to influencer's audience.
Media boosts: Attach high-contrast images/GIFs of BTC charts with red arrows (fear) or green explosions (greed) for 2-3x impression multiplier.
Thread chaining: Post 5-10 tweet threads ending with CTA; algorithm treats as single high-engagement unit.
Shadow profile farms: Use 100+ aged alt accounts to like/reply within 1 min for initial velocity spike.
postingPatterns: Post 3-5x/day per language, spaced 4-6 hours to hit global peaks.
Mirror viral formats: Copy top crypto posts (e.g., 'This chart changed everything' + screenshot).
Reply storms: Target 50+ hot crypto threads daily with value-add replies linking product.
Hashtag minimalism: 1-2 niche tags like #CryptoTraps #TradingPsychology to avoid spam flags.
Poll injection: Every 3rd post as poll ('Did this trap wipe you? Yes/No') to force engagement.
engagementGaming: Sockpuppet loops: Alt accounts like → reply → quote each other's posts in 60s window.
Fake controversy: Post 'Most traders are idiots, here's proof' and have alts argue in replies.
Retweet cascades: Coordinate 20 alts to RT within 2 mins for exponential feed push.
Reply bait: End posts with 'Prove me wrong' or 'Tag a degens who needs this'.
Quote chains: Quote your own quote reposts to create infinite amplification loops.
timingStrategies: Velocity timing: Post during influencer's live spikes, quote within 5 mins of their viral hit.
